text.aria-label: Title text 'Pretraining, B-mix, and the surprise inputs each add 0.0 to 0.2 points of CRPS to S1-pool5 at every lead, so none of them helps Each arm's CRPS minus S1-pool5's by lead day (negative is better), clean half-hours, 4 test months, 5 seeds. The dashed line is S1-pool5 (no pretraining). S1PT-pool5 adds pretraining, S1PT-pool5-Bmix adds pretraining and B-mix, RinjPT-pool5 adds pretraining and drops the surprise inputs. S1 (grey) is one fit without pretraining. S1PT-noemb- pool5 (pretraining, no Primary embedding) is 0.6 to 0.9 points above S1-pool5 and is left off to keep the scale.'
text.tspan: Pretraining, B-mix, and the surprise inputs each add 0.0 to 0.2 points of CRPS to S1-pool5 at every lead,
Each arm's CRPS minus S1-pool5's by lead day (negative is better), clean half-hours, 4 test months, 5 seeds. The
dashed line is S1-pool5 (no pretraining). S1PT-pool5 adds pretraining, S1PT-pool5-Bmix adds pretraining and B-mix,
RinjPT-pool5 adds pretraining and drops the surprise inputs. S1 (grey) is one fit without pretraining. S1PT-noemb-
pool5 (pretraining, no Primary embedding) is 0.6 to 0.9 points above S1-pool5 and is left off to keep the scale.
